name: Vulcan Municipal Campground
note: Six stalls with no hookups beside the arena; first come, first served with self-registration at the booth. The first three nights in a six-month period are free, after that a nightly fee to a 14-day maximum (May-September only); washrooms and dump station May 1 - Sep 30, water tap and camp kitchen, no campfires. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Town of Vulcan camping page + Policy PU-06 (amended 2024-09-23, read 2026-11-10): municipal campground open year round, stalls for campers/trailers/motorhomes/tents, self-registration, no pre-booking; Travel Alberta listing 6015 (read 2026-11-10): six sites, no individual services, sewage disposal, camp kitchen, water tap; Esri imagery 2026-11-10: a gravel camping area of angled stalls ~15 m long between planted grass islands and trees, two small service buildings, two trailers parked in stalls, separate from the arena parking lot -> a real designated-stall campground a 23-ft rig fits, not a lot allowance; Google Maps 'Vulcan Municipality Park (Camp Ground)' at the pin, 4.5 on 42 reviews, phone 403-485-2417. Public: no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery 2026-11-10 (75 m, 250 m and 1.5 km crops around 50.39767,-113.25608): campground in town at Hwy 534 and 1st Ave S, surrounded by streets, arena and farmland; no lake, river or creek within ~1 km. Not waterfront.
fees_source: https://www.townofvulcan.ca/explore/visit/camping (read 2026-11-10): free for 3 consecutive nights in a six-month period, 4th day and every day after $20.00 per night, max 14 consecutive days; PU-06: fee nights May 1 - Sep 30 only.
flags: No RV Life listing found for this campground (RV Life lists only the town's other park, 9021 Virginia Mitchell).
Travel Alberta says 'no individual site services': hookups are none (electric 0, water/sewer no) if that is wanted in the hookups group.
Free nights carry a 3-in-six-months limit; the $20 fee applies from night 4 and only May-Sep.
